title: A3IP installed.json
description: JSON Schema for the per-install record file specified by A3IP v1.10. installed.json is written by the install AI to the package's config_dir immediately after a successful install or upgrade; it is the machine-readable record of what version is installed and where. Published at https://a3ip.dev/schema/v1.10/installed.schema.json. Schema is intentionally permissive: readers MUST tolerate unknown fields (the spec permits future versions to add optional fields without breaking existing readers).

package.description: Package name. MUST match the `name` field in the package's manifest.yaml.

installed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of this install or upgrade. Updated on every upgrade.

platform.description: AI runtime this install lives on. Values match the spec's platform-id convention.

a3ip_spec.description: A3IP spec version used for this install. Reflects the spec version the install AI followed, not necessarily the package's min_a3ip_spec.

config_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing this install's config.json, installed.json, and any other per-install state. Equals the user's `install_dir` config value after path expansion.

upgraded_from.description: Previous version, if this was an upgrade. Omit on fresh installs. Readers tolerate absence.

install_method.description: Runtime-specific install path tag. Used by upgrade flows to choose the right re-install route. Known values include 'cowork-skill' (Cowork Personal Skills UI flow) and 'generic-copy' (file copy into a skills folder, used by Codex / Claude Code). New runtimes may define new values; readers MUST tolerate unknown values.

registry_source.description: Path or URL of the registry this package was installed from. Used by check-for-updates flows. Omit if the install came from a local .a3ip.bundle file.

source_bundle.description: Absolute path to the .a3ip.bundle file used for this install. Useful for audit trail and for re-installs without re-downloading. Omit if the install came directly from a registry URL.

workspace_dir.description: Absolute path to the user's project workspace at install time, if the package interacts with workspace-local files. Omit for packages with no workspace coupling.

backup_dir.description: Absolute path to a backup the install adapter created before overwriting prior package state. Enables rollback. Omit on fresh installs.
